6300.meaning1: independent of others; not relying on another (wrt)
6300.commentary: (UDa) n'āssa paro paccayo, na parassa saddhāya ettha vattatī'ti aparappaccayo.

examples.text: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
kittāvatā ca nu kho bhoto gotamassa sāvako sāsanakaro hoti ovādapatikaro tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane viharatī'ti?

6303.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of aparabhāga

examples.text: atīte kururaṭṭhe indapattanagare dhanañcaye rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto tassa aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā anupubbena viññutaṃ patto takkasilāyaṃ sippāni uggahetvā pitarā uparajje patiṭṭhāpito aparabhāge pitu accayena rajjaṃ patvā dasa rājadhamme akopento kurudhamme vattittha.

6304.grammar: masc, abstr, from na parābhavati, neg

6306.meaning1: not despising others; not disparaging others; not holding others in contempt

examples.text: iti pubb'eva kho pan'assa dussīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, susīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ, ayañ'ca sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā ariyānaṃ apaccanīkatā saddhammasaññatti anatt'ukkaṃsanā aparavambhanā.

6307.meaning1: fact of not despising others; fact of not disparaging others; fact of not treating others with contempt
6307.construction:
na > a + para + vambhī + tā
aparavambhi + tā

examples.text: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, anatt'ukkaṃsakataṃ aparavambhitaṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.

6308.meaning1: not despising others; not disparaging others; not treating others with contempt

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ att'ukkaṃsako paravambhī araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi, anatt'ukkaṃsako aparavambhī'ham'asmi.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu anatt'ukkaṃsako hoti aparavambhī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu anatt'ukkaṃsako hoti aparavambhī, ayam'pi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.

6309.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of apara
6309.meaning1: also; secondly; furthermore; on the other hand

examples.text: idam'avoca āyasmā raṭṭhapālo. idaṃ vatvā atha-aparaṃ etadavoca
yathā'pi uṇhe vijjante, aparaṃ vijjati sītalaṃ, evaṃ tividh'aggi vijjante, nibbānaṃ icchitabbakaṃ.

6310.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of apara

6311.meaning1: not done by another; not another's doing
6311.commentary: (UDa) asayaṃkāro aparaṃkāro'ti n'atthi etassa sayaṃkāro'ti asayaṃkāro, n'atthi etassa parakāro'ti aparakāro. anunāsik'āgamaṃ katvā vuttaṃ aparaṃkāro'ti.

examples.text: santi pan'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti.
kiṃ nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, sayaṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, paraṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, sayaṃkatañ'ca paraṃkatañ'ca jarāmaraṇaṃ, udāhu asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ jarāmaraṇan'ti?

6314.commentary: (SNa) dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti kenaci aparājitaṃ ajj'eva tayo māre madditvā vijitasaṅgāmaṃ imaṃ aparājitasaṅghaṃ dassan'atthāya āgat'amhā'ti attho.

examples.text: etādisāni katvāna, sabbattha'm'aparājitā, sabbattha sotthiṃ gacchanti, taṃ tesaṃ maṅgalam'uttaman'ti.
mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ, devakāyā samāgatā, āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ, dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti.

6315.grammar: masc, pp of na parājeti, neg
6315.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: kāḷ'ūpakāḷā vijito jito ca, aṅgo ca paṅgo ca guttijito ca, passi jahi upadhidukkhamūlaṃ, aparājito mārabalaṃ ajesi.

6316.meaning1: unconquered community; undefeated order; victorious assembly of monks

examples.text: mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ, devakāyā samāgatā, āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ, dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti.

6317.meaning2: (one) who has offended or committed a fault, who has fallen short (of)

6320.meaning1: who has failed; who has erred (in)

examples.text: accayo accagamā'ti aparādho atikkamitvā madditvā gato, aham'ev'ettha aparādhiko. suṅkadāyakaṃ'va bhaṇḍasmin'ti yathā suṅkaṭṭhānaṃ pariharitvā nīte bhaṇḍasmiṃ suṅkadāyakaṃ aparādho abhibhavati, so ca tattha aparādhiko hoti, na rājāno na rājapurisā'ti attho.

6322.commentary: (THIa) kiṃ te aparādhitaṃ mayā'ti kiṃ tuyhaṃ, āvuso, mayā aparaddhaṃ.

examples.text: kiṃ te aparādhitaṃ mayā, yaṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi, na hi pabbajitāya āvuso, puriso samphusanāya kappati.

6324.meaning1: not belonging to another; not subject to another
6324.meaning2: dependent on others, be longing to others

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso dāso assa anatt'ādhīno par'ādhīno na yenakāmaṃgamo. so aparena samayena tamhā dāsabyā mucceyya att'ādhīno apar'ādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṃgamo.

6325.meaning1: fails to do; neglects; does not accomplish
6325.meaning2: lets (something) go wrong or fail; neglects
6325.commentary: (ANa) kiccaṃ aparādhetī'ti kattabbayuttakaṃ kiccaṃ akaronto taṃ aparādheti nāma.

examples.text: katamā ca, gahapati, paññāsampadā? abhijjhā-visamalobh'ābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti. akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.

6326.meaning1: failing to do; neglecting; not accomplishing
6326.meaning2: lets (something) go wrong or fail; neglects
6326.commentary: (ANa) kiccaṃ aparādhetī'ti kattabbayuttakaṃ kiccaṃ akaronto taṃ aparādheti nāma.

examples.text: katamā ca, gahapati, paññāsampadā? abhijjhā-visamalobh'ābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti. akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.
āyuṃ arogiyaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, saggaṃ uccākulīnataṃ, ratiyo patthayantena, uḷārā apar'āparā.

6328.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of aparāpara
6328.meaning1: one after the next; successively; constantly; continuously

examples.text: n'atthi koci bhavo nicco, saṅkhārā vā'pi sassatā, uppajjanti ca te khandhā, cavanti apar'āparaṃ.

6330.meaning1: and then another; and a further

examples.text: aparā'pi kho maṃ, aggivessana, dutiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.

6331.meaning1: not grasped; not clung to; (comm) irreproachable
6331.commentary: (ANa) taṇhādiṭṭhīhi aparāmaṭṭhattā, idaṃ nāma tvaṃ āpannapubbo'ti kenaci parāmaṭṭhuṃ asakkuṇeyyattā ca aparāmaṭṭhāni

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.

6332.grammar: nt, abstr, from na parāmaṭṭha, neg (+instr)
6332.meaning1: fact of being untouchable; fact of being untarnished; fact of being unscathed (by)
6332.construction:
na > a + parā + √mas + ta + tta
aparāmaṭṭha + tta

6333.grammar: prp of na parāmasati, neg, trans (+acc)
6333.meaning1: not clutching; not clinging tightly; not adhering

examples.text: evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati, yañ'ca loke vuttaṃ tena voharati, aparāmasan'ti.
iti yathā yathā naṃ tesu tesu janapadesu sañjānanti, idaṃ kira me āyasmanto sandhāya voharantī'ti, tathā tathā voharati aparāmasaṃ.

6334.meaning1: not dependent on others; independent of another

6336.meaning1: not irritated; not annoyed; not upset; not angered
6336.commentary: (ANa) devatā parikupitā bhavantī'ti vātesu hi visamesu apañjasesu vāyantesu rukkhā bhijjanti, vimānāni bhijjanti. tasmā devatā parikupitā bhavanti, tā devassa sammā vassituṃ na denti. tena vuttaṃ devo na sammā dhāraṃ anuppavecchatī'ti.

examples.text: samaṃ vātesu vāyantesu samesu pañjasesu devatā aparikupitā bhavanti. devatāsu aparikupitāsu devo sammā dhāraṃ anuppavecchati.

6338.commentary: (VIN 1.2.6) aparikkamanaṃ nāma na sakkā hoti yathāyuttena sakaṭena anuparigantuṃ samantā nisseṇiyā anuparigantuṃ. (VINa) saparikkamanaṃ aparikkamanan'ti saupacāraṃ anupacāraṃ.

examples.text: sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅgh'ādiseso.

6339.commentary: (VINa) parikkhitto nāma iṭṭhakapākāraṃ ādiṃ katvā antamaso kaṇṭakasākhāhi'pi parikkhitto.

examples.text: gāmo nāma ekakuṭiko'pi gāmo, dvikuṭiko'pi gāmo, tikuṭiko'pi gāmo, catukuṭiko'pi gāmo, samanusso'pi gāmo, amanusso'pi gāmo, parikkhitto'pi gāmo, aparikkhitto'pi gāmo, gonisādiniviṭṭho'pi gāmo, yo'pi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho so'pi vuccati gāmo.
gām'ūpacāro nāma parikkhittassa gāmassa indakhīle ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto, aparikkhittassa gāmassa ghar'ūpacāre ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto.

6340.meaning1: not exhausted; not consumed; not extinguished; not used up

examples.text: yo ca khv'āyaṃ, gahapati, bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno, tassa'pi kāyasaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, vacīsaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, cittasaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, āyu aparikkhīṇo, usmā avūpasantā, indriyāni vippasannāni.

tassa taṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharato anupaṭṭhitā c'eva sati na upaṭṭhāti, asamāhitañ'ca cittaṃ na samādhiyati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā na parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañ'ca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ n'ānupāpuṇāti.

6341.meaning1: not having possessions; without attachment; without ownership
6341.commentary: (DNa) apariggahā'ti itthipariggahena apariggahā. tesaṃ kira ayaṃ mayhaṃ bhariyā'ti mamattaṃ na hoti, mātaraṃ vā bhaginiṃ vā disvā chandarāgo n'uppajjati.

examples.text: amamā, apariggahā, niyat'āyukā, visesaguṇā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi ṭhānehi uttarakurukā manussā deve ca tāvatiṃse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse.

6344.meaning1: not attended (to); not served; not worshipped

examples.text: santi kho pana, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, aggiparicariyāya suddhī'ti. na kho pana so, sāriputta, aggi sulabharūpo yo mayā apariciṇṇapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, tañ'ca kho raññā vā satā khattiyena muddh'āvasittena brāhmaṇena vā mahāsālena.

6345.meaning1: not attended to before; not previously worshipped

examples.text: santi kho pana, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, aggiparicariyāya suddhī'ti. na kho pana so, sāriputta, aggi sulabharūpo yo mayā apariciṇṇapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, tañ'ca kho raññā vā satā khattiyena muddh'āvasittena brāhmaṇena vā mahāsālena.

6346.meaning1: not given up; not abandoned; not forsaken; not let go of
6346.commentary: (VINa) yathāṭhāne ṭhitam'pi anapekkhatāya na pariccattan'ti apariccattaṃ. (MNa) apariccattan'ti anissaṭṭhaṃ

examples.text: apariccattaṃ kho rañño nāgassa jīvitan'ti.
adinnaṃ nāmaṃ yaṃ adinnaṃ anissaṭṭhaṃ apariccattaṃ rakkhitaṃ gopitaṃ mamāyitaṃ parapariggahitaṃ. etaṃ adinnaṃ nāma.

anāpatti dvetisso rattiyo vasati, ūnakadvetisso rattiyo vasati, dve rattiyo vasitvā tatiyāya rattiyā pur'āruṇā nikkhamitvā puna vasati, sabbacchanne, sabbaaparicchanne, sabbaparicchanne sabbaacchanne, yebhuyyena acchanne, yebhuyyena aparicchanne

6349.grammar: prp of na parijānāti, neg, trans (+acc)
6349.meaning1: not completely comprehending; not totally understanding; not knowing full well
6349.commentary: (SNa) anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahan'ti anabhijānanto aparijānanto avirājento appajahanto.

examples.text: rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya

6350.meaning1: not completely comprehended; not fully understood (by)
6350.commentary: (MNa) apariññātaṃ tassā'ti ettha pana ye saṅkhāre upādāya bhūtānaṃ paññatti, tesaṃ apariññātattā bhūtā apariññātā hontī'ti veditabbā. yojanā pana vuttanayen'eva kātabbā.

examples.text: pathaviṃ pathavito sañjānāti, pathaviṃ pathavito saññatvā pathaviṃ maññati, pathaviyā maññati, pathavito maññati, pathaviṃ me'ti maññati, pathaviṃ abhinandati. taṃ kissa hetu? apariññātaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.
amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, apariññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati apariññātā. amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, pariññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati pariññātā'ti.

6351.grammar: nt, abstr, from na pariññāta, neg
6351.meaning1: fact of not being fully understood; incomplete comprehension
6351.construction:
na > a + pari + √ñā + ta + tta
apariññāta + tta

6352.grammar: ger of na parijānāti, neg, trans (+acc)
6352.meaning1: not completely comprehending; not fully understanding
6352.construction:
na > a + pari + √ñā + ya
na + pariññāya

examples.text: akkheyyasaññino sattā, akkheyyasmiṃ patiṭṭhitā, akkheyyaṃ apariññāya, yogam'āyanti maccuno.

6353.meaning1: not allocated; not designated; not diverted

examples.text: apariṇate vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. apariṇate apariṇatasaññī, anāpatti.
asappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṃ na jānāti, apariṇatabhojī ca hoti, akālacārī ca hoti, abrahmacārī ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā anāyussā.

6355.meaning1: perceiving as not allocated; regarding (something) as not designated

examples.text: apariṇate vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. apariṇate apariṇatasaññī, anāpatti.

6356.grammar: adj, from na paritassati, neg, pass

examples.text: evam'evaṃ te piṇḍiyālopabhojanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa

6357.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from na paritassati, neg, pass

examples.text: siyā pana, bhante, bahiddhā asati aparitassanā'ti? siyā, bhikkhū'ti, bhagavā avoca.

6358.grammar: prp of na paritassati, neg, pass, intrans

examples.text: so evaṃ asamanupassanto na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.

6359.grammar: adj, from na paritassati, neg, pass

examples.text: so antaraghare nisinno samāno na chambhati na kampati na vedhati na paritassati. so achambhī akampī avedhī aparitassī vigatalomahaṃso.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo bhāvitakāyo hoti bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño aparitto mahatto appamāṇavihārī.

6361.commentary: (MNa) aparittan'ti kām'āvacaracittaṃ parittaṃ nāma, tassa paṭikkhepena mahaggataṃ aparittaṃ nāma.

examples.text: vipulena hi me mahaggatena cetasā viharato abhibhuyya lokaṃ adhiṭṭhāya manasā ye pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhā'pi byāpādā'pi sārambhā'pi te na bhavissanti. tesaṃ pahānā aparittañ'ca me cittaṃ bhavissati appamāṇaṃ subhāvitan'ti.

6363.meaningLit: not stood down all around state

examples.text: sabyābajjhaṃ, sāriputta, attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ abhinibbattayato apariniṭṭhitabhāvāya akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, abyābajjhaṃ, sāriputta, attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ abhinibbattayato pariniṭṭhitabhāvāya akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.

6364.meaning1: (of mental defilement) not completely quenched; not entirely emancipated; not completely cooled
6364.construction: na > a + pari + nī + √vā > vu > bu + ta

examples.text: so vata, cunda, attanā adanto avinīto aparinibbuto paraṃ damessati vinessati parinibbāpessatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. so vata, cunda, attanā danto vinīto parinibbuto paraṃ damessati vinessati parinibbāpessatī'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā adantānaṃ dametā, asantānaṃ sametā, aparinibbutānaṃ parinibbāpetā.

6365.meaning2: (of fire) not extinguished; not put out; not quenched
6365.construction: na > a + pari + nī + √vā > vu > bu + ta

6366.meaning2: (of an arahant) not died one's final death; not attained final Nibbāna
6366.construction: na > a + pari + nī + √vā > vu > bu + ta

examples.text: kathaṃ aparipakkato? so pan'āyam'āhāro evarūpe okāse nidhānam'upagato yāva aparipakko hoti, tāva tasmiññ'eva yathāvuttappakāre paramandhakāratimise nānākuṇapa-gandhavāsita-pavanavicarite atiduggandhajegucche padese

6368.meaning1: to be felt when not matured; to be experienced when not fully ripened

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yam'idaṃ kammaṃ paripakkavedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā aparipakkavedanīyaṃ hotū'ti labbham'etan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

6369.grammar: pp of na paripāceti, neg, caus (+instr)
6369.meaning1: not organized; not arranged; not brought to fruition (by)

examples.text: aparipācite paripācitasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. aparipācitte vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. aparipācite aparipācitasaññī, anāpatti.

6370.meaning1: perceiving as not organized; regarding (something) as not arranged

examples.text: aparipācite paripācitasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. aparipācitte vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. aparipācite aparipācitasaññī, anāpatti.

6371.grammar: fem, abstr, from na paripucchati, neg

examples.text: asussūsā aparipucchā paññāya paripantho, ananuyogo apaccavekkhaṇā dhammānaṃ paripantho, micchāpaṭipatti saggānaṃ paripantho

6373.meaning1: incomplete; not whole; without a full set (of)

examples.text: labheyy'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato santike upasampadan'ti. paripuṇṇaṃ pana te, bhikkhu, pattacīvaran'ti? na kho me, bhante, paripuṇṇaṃ pattacīvaran'ti. na kho, bhikkhu, tathāgatā aparipuṇṇapattacīvaraṃ upasampādentī'ti.
atha kho selassa brāhmaṇassa etadahosi, samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsa-mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi, no aparipuṇṇehi, no ca kho naṃ jānāmi buddho vā no vā.

6374.meaning1: whose bowl and (set of) robes are incomplete

examples.text: na kho me, bhante, paripuṇṇaṃ pattacīvaran'ti. na kho, bhikkhu, tathāgatā aparipuṇṇapattacīvaraṃ upasampādentī'ti.

6375.commentary: (VINa) aparipūro nāma aparipuṇṇapattacīvaro. (ANa) sīlesu aparipūrakārī'ti pañcasu sīlesu asamattakārī.

examples.text: sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavaṃ'y'eva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, no ca kho bhikkhū ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, evam'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa ten'aṅgena.
saddho ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu hoti, no ca sīlavā. evaṃ so ten'aṅgena aparipūro hoti. tena taṃ aṅgaṃ paripūretabbaṃ, kin't'āhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ, sīlavā cā'ti!

6376.meaning1: who does not completely fulfil; who is incomplete (wrt); who does not fully practise

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā bhaddāli sabbaṃ taṃ temāsaṃ na bhagavato sammukhībhāvaṃ adāsi, yathā taṃ satthusāsane sikkhāya aparipūrakārī.

6377.grammar: prp of na paripūrati, neg, trans (+acc)
6377.meaning1: not fulfilling; not completing; not actualizing

examples.text: bhāsitā kho pana te esā, ambaṭṭha, ācariyena brāhmaṇena pokkharasātinā vācā, ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupād'āpaccā, kā ca tevijjānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ sākacchā'ti attanā āpāyiko'pi aparipūramāno.

6378.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of na paripūra, neg
6378.construction:
na > a + pari + √pūr + a + aṃ
aparipūra + aṃ

examples.text: puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto hāpetvā lambitvā aparipūraṃ avitthārena parassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti. veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ayaṃ bhavan'ti.

6379.grammar: abs of na paripūreti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
6379.meaning1: having not fulfilled; having not completed; having not accomplished
6379.meaningLit: having not caused to fill all around
6379.construction:
na > a + pari + pūre + tvā
na + paripūretvā

examples.text: ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ aparipūretvā sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. sekhaṃ dhammaṃ aparipūretvā sīlāni paripūressatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

6380.meaning1: not broken; intact; in working order

examples.text: ajjhattikañc'eva, āvuso, cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, n'eva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.

6381.grammar: prp of na paribhuñjati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: taṃ jano n'eva hareyya na piveyya na nahāyeyya na yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya. evañ'hi taṃ, mahārāja, udakaṃ sammā aparibhuñjamānaṃ parikkhayaṃ gaccheyya, no paribhogaṃ.

6382.grammar: prp of pass of na pari √bhuj, neg, pass, intrans
6382.meaning1: not being used; not being enjoyed

examples.text: tassa te bhoge evaṃ sammā aparibhuñjiyamāne rājāno vā haranti corā vā haranti aggi vā ḍahati udakaṃ vā vahati appiyā vā dāy'ādā haranti.

6383.meaning1: not used; not tasted; not enjoyed; not experienced

examples.text: amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, aparibhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparibhuttā. amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, paribhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati paribhuttā'ti
anāpatti ñātikāya dhovantiyā aññātikā dutiyā hoti, avuttā dhovati, aparibhuttaṃ dhovāpeti, cīvaraṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ dhovāpeti, sikkhamānāya, sāmaṇeriyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

6384.meaning1: not insulted; not disrespected; not abused

examples.text: ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ, buddhappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, dhammappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, saṅghappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.

6385.meaning1: (of food) not to be eaten; inedible
6385.commentary: (VINa) aparibhogaṃ vā karotī'ti akhāditabbaṃ vā apātabbaṃ vā karoti, uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā visaṃ vā ucchiṭṭhaṃ vā kuṇapaṃ vā pātesi

examples.text: tīhi kho ahaṃ, jīvaka, ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ aparibhogan'ti vadāmi. diṭṭhaṃ, sutaṃ, parisaṅkitaṃ, imehi kho ahaṃ, jīvaka, tīhi ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ aparibhogan'ti vadāmi.
mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtam'anurakkhe, evam'pi sabbabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.

6388.commentary: (MNa) aparimāṇavaṇṇo'ti tathārūpen'eva sabbaññunā'pi appameyyavaṇṇo, pag'eva mādisenā'ti dasseti. (MNt) aparimāṇavaṇṇā hi buddhā bhagavanto, buddhaguṇasaṃvaṇṇanā jānantassa yathādhammasaṃvaṇṇanaṃ'y'eva anupavisatī'ti.

examples.text: ettake kho ahaṃ, bho, tassa bhoto gotamassa vaṇṇe pariyāpuṇāmi, no ca kho so bhavaṃ gotamo ettakavaṇṇo, aparimāṇavaṇṇo hi so bhavaṃ gotamo.
mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.

suppabuddha tvaṃ manussadaliddo manussakapaṇo manussavarāko, ahaṃ te aparimitaṃ dhanaṃ dassāmi, buddho na buddho, dhammo na dhammo, saṅgho na saṅgho, alaṃ me buddhena, alaṃ me dhammena, alaṃ me saṅghenā'ti vadehī'ti

katamehi catūhi? naṭṭhaṃ na gavesanti, jiṇṇaṃ na paṭisaṅkharonti, aparimitapānabhojanā honti, dussīlaṃ itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ādhipacce ṭhapenti. yāni kānici, bhikkhave, kulāni bhogesu mahattaṃ pattāni na ciraṭṭhitikāni bhavanti, sabbāni tāni imehi catūhi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.

6391.meaning1: not freed; not liberated; not exempt (from)
6391.commentary: (UDa) bhavā aparimuttā'ti yathāvuttena taṇhādiṭṭhigāhena bhavato saṃsārato na parimuttā.

examples.text: upadhiñ'hi paṭicca dukkham'idaṃ sambhoti, sabb'upādānakkhayā n'atthi dukkhassa sambhavo. lokam'imaṃ passa, puthū avijjāya paretā bhūtā bhūtaratā aparimuttā, ye hi keci bhavā sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbe te bhavā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā'ti.
jarādhammo'ti jarāsabhāvo, aparimutto jarāya, jarā nāma mayhaṃ abbhantare'y'eva pavattatī'ti. parato byādhidhammo maraṇadhammo'ti padadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.
aparimeyy'ito kappe, caturo āsuṃ vināyakā, taṇhaṅ'karo medhaṅ'karo, atho'pi saraṇaṅ'karo, dīpaṅ'karo ca sambuddho, ekakappamhi te jinā.

6394.commentary: (PMa) vuttapaṭipakkhena na pariyantā'ti apariyantā, n'atthi etissā pariyanto'ti'pi apariyantā, vuddho etissā pariyanto'ti'pi apariyantā.

examples.text: ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evam'āhaṃsu, antavā ayaṃ loko parivaṭumoti, tesaṃ musā. ananto ayaṃ loko apariyanto. taṃ kissa hetu?

6395.meaning1: unrestricted; without limits; without defined purpose
6395.construction:
na > a + pari + [y] + anta + vant
apariyanta + vant

examples.text: samphappalāpī hoti akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ

6396.grammar: nt, act, from na pariyādāti, neg (+gen)
6396.meaning1: not obsessing; not overpowering; not occupying; not controlling (of)

examples.text: tassa na rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso apariyādānā na c'ev'uttāsavā hoti na ca vighātavā na ca apekkhavā, anupādāya ca na paritassati.

6397.meaning1: not used up; not exhausted; not consumed; not reached the end

examples.text: ayaṃ me mātā, tassā me mātu ayaṃ mātā'ti, apariyādiṇṇā'va bhikkhave, tassa purisassa mātumātaro assu, atha imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.

6398.meaning1: not used up; not exhausted; not consumed; not run out

examples.text: ayaṃ me mātā, tassā me mātu ayaṃ mātā'ti, apariyādinnā'va bhikkhave, tassa purisassa mātumātaro assu, atha imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.
yāvakīvañ'ca me, sāriputta, sakaṃ muttakarīsaṃ apariyādinnaṃ hoti, sakaṃ'y'eva sudaṃ muttakarīsaṃ āhāremi. idaṃsu me, sāriputta, mahāvikaṭabhojanasmiṃ hoti.

6399.meaning1: not overwhelmed; not overpowered; not under the control of

examples.text: yadapi aluddho lobhena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto na parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati, vadhena vā bandhanena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā balav'amhi bal'attho iti'pi tadapi kusalaṃ.
aluddho pan'āyaṃ, kālāmā, purisapuggalo lobhena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto n'eva pāṇaṃ hanati
